name: Tag
purpose: Display compact metadata with optional navigation and removal.
intent: Represent entities and contextual metadata throughout LegacyHQ.

apiAdaptationNotes: isInteractive has no corresponding Figma variant - added 2026-08-20 so Tag can be composed as a plain focusable button trigger (no navigation, no remove affordance) elsewhere in the system. Gated as isInteractive || typeof onClick === 'function', the same pattern Avatar already uses for its own isInteractive prop. First consumer: Tag Group's '+N more' overflow tag, which opens a Dropdown Menu on click.

keyboardInteraction: Tab navigates independently between link and remove button
Space/Enter activates the interactive tag button when isInteractive (or onClick with no href/isRemovable) is set - native button behavior, no custom key handling
behaviorRules: Navigation and removal are separate interactive regions.
Remove button uses independent hover, press, and focus states.
Tag body uses tone-specific interaction states.

When there is no href and isRemovable is false, isInteractive (or a plain onClick) renders a native button instead of a non-interactive span - no navigation, no remove affordance, just a focusable click target.
implementationNotes: Rounded clipping handled by painted child surfaces.
dont: Merge navigation and removal into one interactive target.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders a native button (not a span) when isInteractive or onClick is set with no href/isRemovable
